nodes.prompt:
TASK: In a NEW git worktree of /Users/yeongyu/local-workspaces/omo (branch fix/dag-sdk-error-surfacing off origin/dev), make the eval-cell DAG SDK surface real dag-tool errors instead of the opaque run_id message, with failing-first tests, open a PR to dev, drive CI green, and WORK UNTIL THE PR IS MERGED.

CONFIRMED DEFECT (verified live 2026-08-21 at origin/dev; re-read the files to re-anchor exact lines):
- packages/omo-senpi/plugin/runtime/dag/sdk.js start() reads response?.details?.run_id ?? response?.run_id and, when absent, throws new Error("The dag start response did not include a run_id.").
- When the dag tool REJECTS a call it returns this shape (captured from a live incident): {"content":[{"type":"text","text":"dag run key \"X\" already exists with a different definition"}],"details":{"kind":"error","error":{"code":"definition_conflict","message":"dag run key \"X\" already exists with a different definition","nodes":[],"errors":[],"diagnostics":[],"node_ids":[]}}} - there is no details.run_id, so the SDK hid a definition_conflict behind the generic message and the operator had to probe the raw tool from a Python cell.
- The same opaque pattern exists in packages/omo-senpi/plugin/runtime/dag/library.js around lines 86-88 ("dag library: the dag start response did not include a run_id.").

REQUIRED BEHAVIOR:
- In sdk.js add ONE choke point (in callDag or a helper applied to every action's response): when response?.details?.kind === "error", throw an Error whose message contains BOTH details.error.code and details.error.message, e.g. dag start failed: definition_conflict: dag run key "X" already exists with a different definition. Include the action name. Fall back to the first content[].text, then a generic message, when error fields are missing.
- Keep the existing run_id throw for well-formed non-error responses that still lack a run_id.
- Apply the same error surfacing to the start path in library.js.
- sdk.js and library.js MUST stay dependency-free (no imports): they are loaded raw inside the eval worker with no node_modules resolver.

TDD (failing-first, MANDATORY): extend packages/omo-senpi/src/extension/dag-sdk.test.ts - it stubs globalThis.tool and imports the shipped sdk.js artifact - with cases where the stub returns the definition_conflict error shape above for start (and at least one other action, e.g. wait or attach): assert the thrown message contains definition_conflict AND the human message. Capture the RED test output BEFORE touching production code, paste it in the PR body, then capture GREEN after. Cover library.js the same way (extend its existing test file if one exists, else add one next to dag-sdk.test.ts following its stub pattern).

SCOPE: write ONLY inside your new omo worktree: packages/omo-senpi/plugin/runtime/dag/**, packages/omo-senpi/src/extension/** (tests), and the evidence dir. The senpi repo (/Users/yeongyu/local-workspaces/senpi) is OUT OF SCOPE - a sibling node owns it.

REPO LAW (omo): Conventional Commits (match git log). Commit QA evidence under .omo/evidence/<YYYYMMDD>-<slug>/ using git add -f (evidence dirs are gitignored-but-tracked). The omo-senpi suite has env-sensitive failures: run tests from REPO ROOT (bun test <specific test files>), and if unrelated tests fail, attribute against a pristine origin/dev baseline before blaming your change.

VERIFY: (1) the extended test files pass in ONE bun test run from repo root; (2) repo typecheck/lint as configured stays green for touched files; (3) PR CI fully green.

PR: base dev, title fix(omo-senpi): surface dag tool errors through the eval SDK, body = root cause + incident evidence + RED/GREEN outputs. Enable auto-merge (gh pr merge --auto --merge). dev is a hot lane: if the PR goes DIRTY, rebase and re-push until merged. Report WORKING: <phase> before long test or CI waits.

STOP WHEN: gh pr view --json state shows MERGED into dev AND your worktree is removed (git worktree remove). Report the PR number, merge commit SHA, evidence paths, and the RED/GREEN capture locations.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: In a NEW git worktree of /Users/yeongyu/local-workspaces/senpi (branch fix/js-kernel-local-roots off origin/main), plumb localRoots and artifactsDir into the JavaScript eval kernel so js cells support local:// paths like every other kernel, with a failing-first test, open a PR to main, drive CI green, and WORK UNTIL THE PR IS MERGED.

CONFIRMED DEFECT (verified live 2026-08-21 at origin/main; re-read the files to re-anchor exact lines):
- packages/senpi-codemode/src/extension/session-manager.ts #createKernel: the early-return if (language === "js") { return new JavaScriptKernel({ sessionId, cwd, parallelPoolWidth, onMessage }) } sits ABOVE the block that computes const localRoots = this.#options.localRoots ?? (this.#options.artifactsDir ? { local: join(this.#options.artifactsDir, "local") } : undefined) and the connection object that spreads localRoots and artifactsDir - so py/rb/jl kernels receive connection.localRoots + connection.artifactsDir and the JS kernel receives NEITHER.
- Downstream is already wired and waiting: packages/senpi-codemode/src/kernels/js/worker-core.js lines 40-41 read message.connection.localRoots and message.connection.artifactsDir into JsWorkerRuntime options; worker-runtime.js lines 22-23 consume options.localRoots with an artifactsDir -> join(artifactsDir, "local") fallback; worker-runtime.js line 184 throws Protocol paths are not supported by <op>() when no root reaches it.
- The JS kernel worker init connection is built by localBridgeConnection(this.#options) at packages/senpi-codemode/src/kernels/js/context-manager.ts:189; the JavaScriptKernelOptions type lives in packages/senpi-codemode/src/kernels/js/local-module-loader.ts.
- LIVE PROOF of the asymmetry (same session, same install): py write("local://f.txt","x") resolved under the session artifacts local/ dir; js write("local://f.txt","x") threw Protocol paths are not supported by write(). The js prelude doc line (packages/senpi-codemode/src/kernels/js/prelude.ts:7) already PROMISES that local:// uses the session local root.

REQUIRED BEHAVIOR: js cells' read()/write() accept local:// exactly like py. session-manager computes localRoots once (hoist the computation above the js early-return) and passes localRoots + artifactsDir into JavaScriptKernel options; JavaScriptKernelOptions and localBridgeConnection carry them into the worker init connection consumed by worker-core.js. Zero behavior change for py/rb/jl kernels.

TDD (failing-first, MANDATORY): add a test at the lowest REAL seam - e.g. assert localBridgeConnection includes localRoots/artifactsDir when the options carry them, AND/OR drive the real JavaScriptKernel with artifactsDir set and assert a js cell write("local://f.txt","x") resolves under <artifactsDir>/local/f.txt. Mirror the existing test harness in packages/senpi-codemode (find neighboring *.test.ts for the js kernel first and follow their patterns). Capture the RED output BEFORE the production edit, paste it in the PR body, then capture GREEN.

SCOPE: write ONLY inside your new senpi worktree, under packages/senpi-codemode/**. The omo repo (/Users/yeongyu/local-workspaces/omo) is OUT OF SCOPE - a sibling node owns it.

REPO LAW (senpi): Conventional Commits per git log. Read the repo root AGENTS.md and packages/senpi-codemode AGENTS.md (if present) and obey their test/PR/QA rules.

VERIFY: (1) new test RED then GREEN in one bun test run from the repo's canonical test CWD; (2) repo typecheck/lint green for touched files; (3) PR CI fully green.

STOP WHEN: gh pr view --json state shows MERGED into main AND your worktree is removed. Report the PR number, merge commit SHA, and the RED/GREEN capture locations.
